rules.name: Mortar Pit
rules.description: 3 men and an 81mm mortar in reinforced cover. The cover is lost if the mortar team moves.

rules.name: Machine Gun Pillbox
rules.description: 3 men and a tripod MG34 in hardened cover. The cover is lost if the MG team move.

rules.name: Machine Gun Dug-out
rules.description: 3 men and a tripod MG34 in reinforced cover. The cover is lost if the MG team move.

rules.name: Machine Gun Dug-out
rules.description: 3 men and a tripod MG34 in reinforced cover. The cover is lost if the MG team move.

rules.name: Command Bunker
rules.description: A command post in a bunker, providing hardened cover.  The cover is lost if the comand team moves.

rules.name: Artillery Observation Post
rules.description: A Forward Observer Team in reinforced cover.  The cover is lost if the observer team move.

rules.name: Off-table 88mm Anti-Tank Shot
rules.description: The positions are covered by 88s well-camouflaged behind the lines. You may take a single 88mmL56 Aimed Fire – Armour-Piercing shot at an enemy vehicle within 30" of your table edge. The shot will hit on a dice roll of 6, with a penetration value of 6. This requires no orders to use.

rules.name: Fortified Bocage
rules.description: A 10" length of bocage hedgerow, anywhere on the table, this counts as reinforced cover rather than hard cover.

rules.name: Gun Dug-out
rules.description: Reinforced cover for a single gun and crew, until the gun moves. The gun (anti-tank, artillery, anti-aircraft, etc.) must be purchased separately from the army list.

rules.name: Sniper Hideout
rules.description: A single sniper in reinforced cover. It can be placed anywhere outside of the opponent’s deployment zone. The cover is lost if the sniper moves.

rules.name: Bridge Demolitions
rules.description: A chosen bridge, anywhere on the table, has been wired with demolition charges.  Before the game, write down which turn the bridge will blow-up.  At the start of that turn, roll a D6.  On a 2+ the bridge is destroyed.  Any units on the bridge are also destroyed.  On a 1, the charge fails to go off!

rules.name: Tunnels
rules.description: There are sewers, mine workings, S-Bahn tunnels or other underground access in the area to a single building, anywhere on the table.  Before the game, write down which building has tunnel access and on which turn up to six infantry units (kept in reserve off the table) will be deployed into it.  At the start of that turn, place the infantry units in the building and then give them Orders as normal.

rules.name: Timed Demolition
rules.description: A chosen building, anywhere on the table, has been wired with demolition charges.  Before the game, write down which turn the building will blow-up.  At the start of that turn, roll a D6.  On a 2+ the building is reduced to rubble.  On a 1, the charge fails to go off!  Any units in the building take 7/3+ damage with no cover saves allowed, and are automatically pinned.

rules.name: Cellar Shelter
rules.description: A single chosen building, anywhere on the table, has had its cellar reinforced against air raids.  Any units in the building have a 2+ Cover Save against Indirect Fire that hits them.  This does not effect Aimed or Area Fire.
